title: Explicit Cech construction of the right adjoint for derived torsion complexes
author: The Stacks Project Authors
difficulty_reason: The proof constructs the right adjoint on the unbounded derived category by an extended Cech total complex. It proves torsion of its cohomology using a filtered colimit of Koszul complexes and null homotopies, then proves the counit is invertible on the torsion subcategory. These are actual derived-category construction obligations rather than substitution into a local-cohomology formula.
